title: The Eagar Corpus: the recorded teaching of Thomas W. Eagar (MIT, 2011-2022)
description:
The Eagar Corpus is an edited scholarly edition of 231 lectures (215 of them Eagar's own teaching; 16 guest lectures or educational films shown in class), approximately 1.5 million words, self-recorded by Thomas W. Eagar (1950-2022), Professor of Materials Engineering at MIT, between 2011 and 2022, spanning welding metallurgy, fusion and solid-state welding, corrosion, casting, deformation processing, materials selection, codes and standards, and total quality improvement.

Lectures are presented in editorial layers running from the unmodified auto-caption transcript through to a readable edition with scholarly annotation. Each lecture carries a stable identifier of the form CODE_TERMYEAR_NN (e.g. WM_Su2014_01); passages are cited by identifier plus paragraph anchor. The deposit also includes a deduplicated canonical case index with function tags, the editorial convention catalogue, per-lecture editorial and transformation registers, and the pipeline code.

Browse the corpus at https://r-h-taylor.github.io/eagar-corpus/

Each release carries its own version DOI, shown on this page. To cite the corpus as a whole, use the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20226048, which always resolves to the latest version.
